symptom: `alter page … { set Label = 'X' on <widget> }` prints "Altered page" and DESCRIBE still shows the old (or no) label — on an input widget that shows no label, and on a button
cause: setWidgetLabelMut fell through to `return nil` when the widget had neither a LabelTemplate document nor a legacy Label/Caption. A label-less input stores `LabelTemplate: null` (codec NullFields), so DGetDoc returns nil and nothing is written; a button has no label slot at all and got the same silent nil
insight: The earlier half-fix (#292 Title + LabelTemplate doc) only tested a widget that already HAD a label — the shape that worked. Test the null slot and the no-slot widget, not just the populated one: every `DGetDoc(...) != nil` guard that ends in `return nil` is a silent no-op for the null case. Null LabelTemplate on a built-in input gets the same ClientTemplate create page writes (bson dump identical); on a CustomWidget it is refused, because every pluggable widget writes `LabelTemplate: null` whether or not its definition declares a Label system property. The refusal also surfaces in `check --references` via the setter probe
